name: plain body, no params, no includes
one uniform line per param; color becomes vec3; declared in order
body: void main() { fragColor = vec4(p_speed, p_bands, float(p_glow), 1.0) * vec4(p_tint, 1.0); }

name: include is replaced in place; second include of the same file becomes one comment line
nested includes are expanded recursively; once-only applies across nesting
missing include becomes an #error line at the same position
include directive matching: leading whitespace ok; trailing text or single quotes are not includes
CRLF input is normalised to LF; missing final newline is tolerated
